name: attention
description: What needs a look right now, what will need one soon, what was found and is not watched, what is snoozed, issues in other environments, and how many things are fine.

name: find
description: Search services by name. Optionally only on one machine, in one environment or of one kind. A list longer than limit (default 100) answers {items, next}: pass next as cursor for the following page.

name: service
description: One service: its state, checks, routing, facts, version on each machine, recent deploys, stats and open issue. Takes the id from find.

name: jobs
description: Every job with its schedule, last run (with done and total while it runs), last good run and next expected run. state is ok, degraded, down or unknown.

name: job_runs
description: The recent runs of one job, newest first, with their output and, while running, done and total. Takes the job's id from jobs. result is running, ok or fail.

name: logs
description: Search log lines, newest first. level is that level and worse.

name: snooze
description: Snooze an issue until a time (RFC 3339). Takes the issue id from attention.

name: acknowledge
description: Mark an issue as seen.

name: errors
description: Error groups, newest first. With an id from that list, one group with its stack and its individual reports, newest first, paged by cursor.

name: since_deploy
description: The latest deploy of one service, and the issues and errors first seen after it. Takes the id from find.

name: machines
description: Every machine with its state and what it runs.

name: machine
description: One machine. Takes the id from machines.

name: issues
description: Issues, newest first. state is open, snoozed, closed or all; without it, the open and snoozed ones.

name: issue
description: One issue with its history: opened, notes, acknowledged, snoozed, closed. Takes the id from issues or attention.

name: deploys
description: Deploys of every service, newest first.

name: versions
description: The versions of the apps Dokkit watches, and the apps.

name: rules
description: The alert rules, first match first.

name: proposals
description: Things Dokkit found that a person may accept or dismiss: services, ports, jobs, containers and sites, each with an origin (system, software or yours; absent when the machine's program is too old to say) and the reason. The operating system's own things (origin system) are left out unless system is true, and counted in hidden, in total and for each machine. Answers items, next and hidden.

name: series
description: Numbers over time for one service, or for a machine's own disks, memory and processor when given machine instead of id. Without metric, lists the metric names. from and to are RFC 3339 and default to the last day.

name: processes
description: A machine's newest process list, taken about once a minute: name, pid, memory (bytes and percent of the machine's memory), processor percent (null on a first sample), path. sort is memory (default) or cpu; q matches name or path; pid picks one process; limit defaults to 50, at most 10,000. Answers at, total_memory_bytes, items and count (all that matched).

name: process_history
description: The top 10 processes by memory or by processor of a machine, one list a minute, up to 24 hours back. kind is memory (default) or cpu; from and to are RFC 3339 and default to the last hour.

name: day
description: The last 24 hours in half hours: for each machine, which half hours had something down, something that needed a look, nothing, or no signal, and the issues that opened. to is RFC 3339 and defaults to now.

name: unsnooze
description: Wake a snoozed issue.

name: note
description: Add a note to an issue.

name: bulk
description: Snooze, unsnooze or acknowledge many issues at once. snooze needs until (RFC 3339).

name: watch
description: Start watching a service. Takes the id from find.

name: unwatch
description: Stop watching a service. Its open issues close.

name: routing
description: Set where a service's issues go when it stops (down) and when it struggles (degraded), and with night false whether they wait for morning at night. Each is one channel or a list of channels, each of which sends its own alert; none stands alone. A field left out stays as it was; an empty down or degraded clears the route.

name: machine_routing
description: Set how a machine that stops reporting is announced: down is one channel or a list (empty for the server-wide choice for down), and night false holds the alert until the night ends (true, the default, wakes someone). A field left out stays as it was.

name: hold
description: Hold a service at a version, so a newer one is not offered. An empty or missing version lets it go.

name: accept_proposal
description: Accept found services and ports: one (id), some (ids) or every one waiting and shown (all true; the operating system's own only with system true). Takes the ids from proposals; a hidden one can be accepted by id.

name: dismiss_proposal
description: Dismiss proposals: one (id), some (ids) or every one waiting and shown (all true; the operating system's own only with system true). Takes the ids from proposals; a hidden one can be dismissed by id.

name: add_rule
description: Add an alert rule at the end of the list. kind is job, check, machine or empty for anything; state is down, degraded or empty for both.

name: update_rule
description: Change an alert rule. A field left out stays as it was; an empty one clears it. Takes the id from rules. on false switches the rule off.

name: delete_rule
description: Delete an alert rule.

name: set_checks
description: Replace the checks added in the interface for a service. Checks from a file are left alone.

name: allow_restart
description: Allow or forbid restarting a service from Dokkit.

name: keys
description: Every key and token, with its kind, label and scopes. Never the key text.

name: make_key
description: Make a key. kind user needs label and scopes, app needs service, enrol takes an optional machine name. The key text is returned once.

name: revoke_key
description: Revoke a key. Takes the id from keys.

name: people
description: The people who can sign in, with their roles.

name: add_person
description: Add a person who can sign in.

name: remove_person
description: Remove a person. Takes the id from people.

name: alert_settings
description: The alert settings: who is told by default, the limits, the night and the mail settings. Addresses, user names and secrets are only shown as set or not set.

name: alert_people
description: The people alerts can be told, each with their own destinations: email, phone for SMS, iMessage address, ntfy address, Pushover user key and PagerDuty routing key. The ntfy address, Pushover key and routing key are only shown as set or not set.

name: alert_who
description: Who is told at each level where someone is named: the default, a rule, a service, a check. Where nothing is named the level above decides, and the default is everyone.

name: alert_suggestions
description: Changes Dokkit suggests: an issue that keeps opening and is snoozed, which the daily digest could take instead.

name: archives
description: The archived months of logs that can be loaded back.

name: keep_messages
description: Keep the text of a service's errors from now on, or stop keeping it.

name: set_job_timing
description: Set when a job counts as late (grace) and as run too long (max_runtime), such as 30m or 2h. A field left out stays as it was; an empty one clears it. A job from a dokkit.toml is changed in the file.

name: update_program
description: Ask an enrolled machine to fetch the newer dokkit program. A person finishes the update on the machine. Takes the id from machines.

name: releases
description: The program releases this server holds, each with its files and whether it is complete. Only a complete release can be approved.

name: certificate
description: The certificates this server serves itself: the installed one and the uploaded one, each with its names, issuer, when it runs out, whether it is self-signed and its SHA-256 fingerprint.

name: set_certificate
description: Put a certificate for a real name in place: cert is the PEM of the certificate followed by its chain, key is its PEM private key. It is served at once to clients that ask for one of its names.

name: remove_certificate
description: Remove the uploaded certificate.

name: certificate_settings
description: The settings for getting and renewing the uploaded certificate by itself: the DNS name, the certificate authority's directory, and whether a Cloudflare token is set. The token is never shown.

name: set_certificate_settings
description: Change those settings: acme_name (such as example.dokkit.page), acme_cloudflare_token (a Cloudflare API token that may edit DNS in the name's zone; an empty one clears it) and acme_directory (Let's Encrypt production when empty). A setting left out stays as it was.

name: renew_certificate
description: Get a certificate for acme_name now from the certificate authority, proving the name with a DNS record at Cloudflare, or through the names.dokkit.dev claim service for a name claimed there. It can take a few minutes. Answers with the certificates, or the reason it failed.

name: dokkit_name
description: The name on dokkit.page this server holds through the claim service, if any: the name, the address set for it (empty means this machine's own), the address last sent, and whether that worked.

name: claim_dokkit_name
description: Claim a name on dokkit.page with the one-time claim code from names.dokkit.dev: this server registers a key with the claim service, makes the name acme_name and points it at address (empty for this machine's own). Without a code, changes only the address. Follow with renew_certificate.

name: update_machine
description: Ask the updater on a machine to move to a release this server holds completely, such as v1.2.3. Takes the id from machines and the version from releases. Only a signed release installs.

name: scan_machine
description: Ask an enrolled machine to look itself over again and send what it finds to proposals. Read-only on the machine; nothing found is watched until accepted. Takes the id from machines. Answers with the run id; a program too old to know it refuses.

name: plan_downtime
description: Say an enrolled machine is going down on purpose, such as for a restart: for the time given, `for` (such as 15m, at most 4h), it opens no issue for going silent or for its checks failing, and sends nothing. When the time is up the usual rules resume at once. A second call replaces the window; `for` of 0 ends it. Issues already open stay open. Takes the id from machines.

name: end_downtime
description: End a machine's planned downtime now. Takes the id from machines.

name: downtime_schedules
description: The planned downtime scheduled for a machine, each with its id, repeat, time, days, length in seconds, reason, who made it and when it next starts. Takes the id from machines.

name: schedule_downtime
description: Schedule planned downtime for an enrolled machine, so it starts by itself. repeat is once (with at, an RFC 3339 time), daily or weekly (with time, such as 02:00 in the server's night time zone, or UTC when none is set; weekly also takes days, 1 for Monday to 7 for Sunday). `for` is the length (such as 30m, at most 4h). A window it starts is not ended early when the machine comes back. Takes the id from machines.

name: remove_scheduled_downtime
description: Remove a scheduled planned downtime. Takes the id from machines and the schedule from downtime_schedules.

name: update_all
description: Ask the updater on every machine that has one to move to a release this server holds completely, such as v1.2.3.

name: add_app
description: Add an app that runs on many machines, such as a desktop program. Its key is returned once and goes into the app's build.

name: add_dependency
description: Add something outside that is depended on, such as a payment service. With check, a machine that runs dokkit (machine) tests it: {type http, url} or {type tcp, address host:port}. Without a check it belongs to the group Outside.

name: add_job
description: Add a job to watch. The key and the addresses the job calls are returned once. schedule is a cron line read as UTC; grace and max_runtime are times such as 30m.

name: set_alert_settings
description: Change alert settings. A setting left out stays as it was; an empty secret clears it. If the address a secret is sent to changes (ntfy_url, smtp_host), send the secret again in the same call or it is cleared, and the answer says so. Addresses must be https, not this machine; mail ports are 25, 465, 587 and 2525.

name: test_alert
description: Send a test alert by one channel, to the server-wide destination or, with person, to that person's. Answers sent, or one fixed reason. A page, or a push through PagerDuty, stays open for two minutes and then resolves itself. Four at once, then one every 25 seconds; a test that stays open costs twice as much: two at once, then one every 50 seconds.

name: set_alert_person
description: Change a person's destinations. Takes the id from alert_people. A destination left out stays as it was; an empty one clears it.

name: set_alert_who
description: Name who is told at one level. scope is default, rule, service or check; id is the rule, service or check (not for default); for a check, service and name may be sent instead of id; to is a list of person ids from alert_people, ["everyone"] for the server-wide destinations, or ["oncall"] for whoever is on call in the chosen PagerDuty schedule. An empty list names nobody there, so the level above decides. The check comes before the service, the service before the rule, the rule before the default.

name: alert_oncall
description: The PagerDuty schedules, read with the REST API key in the alert settings, and who is on call now in the chosen schedule, with the person on this server that is. Kept for a minute.

name: accept_suggestion
description: Send that service's issues to the daily digest from now on. Takes the id from alert_suggestions.

name: dismiss_suggestion
description: Dismiss an alert suggestion. Takes the id from alert_suggestions.

name: restore_archive
description: Load an archived month of logs back for a week. Takes the name from archives.

name: settings
description: Every value Dokkit decides on its own for the whole server: values is each one now, defaults what Reset gives, changed the ones that differ.

name: set_settings
description: Change server-wide values. values maps a name from settings to a whole number, true or false, or text for a list of lengths; null or an empty text puts one back to its default. Names left out stay as they were.

name: machine_settings
description: One machine's values: each starts at the server-wide one. Takes the id from machines.

name: set_machine_settings
description: Change one machine's values, as set_settings does. Takes the id from machines.

name: job_settings
description: One job's values: each starts at the job's own file, or the server-wide one. Takes the id from jobs.

name: set_job_settings
description: Change one job's values, as set_settings does. Takes the id from jobs.
